verdict.rationale: Box documents a full-text search API (box-docs-5) that goes beyond filename/prefix matching, explicitly finding content via full-text queries, and metadata is also queryable via metadata templates/instances/queries (box-docs-38), extending search capability to custom fields. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality or coverage limits (e.g., which file types are indexed), and no detailed API reference snippet showing query parameters.
